changelog.body:
What's changed

1. Added Denial records: see which apps are being blocked from changing volume in the background and add them to the allowlist directly.
2. Added detection of the active Xposed framework (LSPosed, Vector, etc.) and framework-specific UI text.
3. Fixed several minor issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xxtvrxx233/OplusStreamVolumeBypass/compare/1.0...1.1

# Background

See [this post](https://www.reddit.com/r/oneplus/comments/1b69srj/)

## Source

- Main repository: [xxtvrxx233/OplusStreamVolumeBypass](https://github.com/xxtvrxx233/OplusStreamVolumeBypass)

# Usage

1. Download the latest release apk
2. Install and enable the module in your Xposed Manager
3. Make sure the recommended scope is selected
4. Reboot the device

# Compatibility

- Support ColorOS (OxygenOS) 14 ~ 17

# Disclaimer

Portions of this project were developed with AI assistance. The maintainer has
reviewed, built, and tested the code. The software is provided "as is", without
